theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months of expenses, protecting you from unexpected financial shocks before investing.
caption: Start small, stay consistent. Your emergency fund is the foundation of all good money habits. Having savings set aside prevents reliance on high-cost borrowing when life surprises you. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #MoneyHabits #FinancialSecurity #SmartSaving
